Here are today’s headlines – the latest news in the Philippines and around the world:

items: Supreme Court dismisses petitions vs Rodrigo Duterte’s ICC arrest

blocks.text: The Supreme Court dismisses the consolidated petitions questioning the arrest of former president Rodrigo Duterte in March 2025.

items: Dela Rosa seeks dismissal of absenteeism complaint

blocks.text: Senator Bato dela Rosa asks the Senate ethics committee to dismiss a complaint against him over his prolonged absence from the Senate.

items: Cayetano wants to let ‘generous’ Filipinos cover gov’t debt. Any takers?

blocks.text: Senator Alan Peter Cayetano proposes a mechanism for individual taxpayers to contribute their share of the national debt, calculated at over P170,000 per Filipino.

items: Nvidia reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO

blocks.text: Nvidia reinstates Jensen Huang as chief executive, effective immediately.

items: Alex Eala comes home with best season yet

blocks.text: Filipina tennis superstar Alex Eala comes home, as she wraps up her best season so far, with her first WTA title and a career-high ranking of no. 15. – Rappler.com
